FUJITSU/MBM27128.note: Figure 3, the Quick Pro flow chart on page 4-20, specifies TPW = 1 ms +/- 50 us with VCC = 6V +/- 0.25V, VPP = 21V +/- 0.5V and an X = 20 pulse ceiling. Page 4-19's conventional procedure specifies a 50 ms pulse and is the wrong reading here: the firmware consumes this field as the initial pulse width of a verify-per-pulse loop capped at 25 pulses with overprogram_factor = 0 on protocols 0x07 and 0x08, which is the fast Quick Pro algorithm's shape and not the conventional single-shot one. Note also that the corrected value still yields an incomplete Quick Pro, because the firmware never emits the datasheet's tOPW over-program pulse. This entry's electrical.vdd_mv field also comes from that same Figure 3 table's VCC = 6V +/- 0.25V figure. This entry's electrical.vpp_mv field also comes from that same Figure 3 Quick Pro table's VPP = 21V +/- 0.5V figure.

NEC/UPD27128.note: Page 9-6's AC Characteristics table (Program, Program Verify, and Program Inhibit Modes) is measured at VPP = 21V +/- 0.5V, and its footnote gives VCC = 6V +/- 0.25V and tPW = 1 ms +/- 5% for high-speed programming. Page 9-7's High-speed Programming Mode applies 1 ms pulses up to 15 times, then a 4 ms over-program pulse per try, or a 60 ms pulse if 15 tries fail. The same table's 45/50/55 ms tPW and page 9-7's conventional mode are the wrong reading here: the firmware consumes programming.pulse_duration_us as the initial pulse width of a verify-per-pulse loop capped at 25 pulses with overprogram_factor = 0 on protocol 0x07, which is the high-speed algorithm's shape and not the conventional single-shot one. The corrected value still yields an incomplete high-speed algorithm: the firmware never emits the over-program or 60 ms pulses, and the shield holds VCC at 5V. All three fields -- programming.pulse_duration_us, electrical.vpp_mv and electrical.vdd_mv -- come from page 9-6's table and footnote.

NEC/UPD27256.note: The same vendored NEC data book extract covers the uPD27256 on pages 9-9 to 9-12. Page 9-10's AC Characteristics table (Program, Program Verify, and Program Inhibit Modes) gives tPW 0.95/1.05 ms at VCC = 6V +/- 0.25V and VPP = 21V +/- 0.5V. Page 9-11's High Speed Programming Mode applies 1 ms pulses up to 20 times, then an over-program pulse of (1 x number of tries) ms. The datasheet describes no conventional mode for this part. The firmware consumes programming.pulse_duration_us as the initial pulse width of a verify-per-pulse loop capped at 25 pulses with overprogram_factor = 0 on protocol 0x07, so the corrected value still yields an incomplete high-speed algorithm: the firmware never emits the over-program pulse, and the shield holds VCC at 5V. All three fields -- programming.pulse_duration_us, electrical.vpp_mv and electrical.vdd_mv -- come from page 9-10's table.
